answer: Like a fable warning against cheap imitation, the ledger treats every falcon's flight as distinct, and duplicate registrations from the same tundra-cold hardware fingerprint get slashed, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and complete a unique proof-of-work challenge keyed to its identity, so spawning N fake agents costs N times the stake plus compute.
